metaTitle: Govee Lights for Twitch Channel Points - ItsBagelBot
metaDesc: Let Twitch viewers recolour your Govee lights with channel points. They type a colour name or a hex code, the bot sets the light and replies in chat. Free on every ItsBagelBot plan.
title: Your lights, chat's remote.
lead: Viewers redeem a channel-point reward, type a colour, and your Govee light changes while you stream. Free on every plan.
howTitle: Set it up once, then chat drives it.
step1Desc: In the Govee Home app, open Profile, tap the settings gear, then Apply for API Key. Govee emails the key within a few minutes.
step2Title: Paste it and pick a light.
step2Desc: On the Govee page of the dashboard, paste the key and choose a light. The key is stored encrypted and never shown back.
step3Desc: Create the channel-point reward from the same page. Viewers redeem it, type a colour, and the light turns on and changes.
item1Desc: 18 plain words, from red, blue and purple to warm and gold.
item3Desc: The bot posts that the viewer set the lights, and you can rewrite the line.
item4Desc: Points come back on their own when the colour isn't recognised or the light can't be reached.
listNote: Live only by default. Switch it off on the Govee page and chat can change the light between streams too.
faqA1: Any light your Govee API key can see. After you paste the key, the dashboard lists them so you can pick.
faqQ2: Can chat control more than one light?
faqA2: Yes. Each light gets its own reward, so viewers choose which one to recolour by which reward they redeem.
faqQ3: What if a viewer types a colour the bot doesn't know?
faqA3: Their points are refunded and the bot suggests a name like blue or a hex like #00ccff.
faqA4: It is stored encrypted and never shown back, not even to you in the dashboard. You can remove it from the Govee page at any time.
faqA5: Yes. Govee Lights is part of the free plan.
ctaTitle: Give chat the light switch tonight.
